newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB sells wheat to Sri Lanka and Sudan.
newsitem.headline: AWB sells wheat to Sri Lanka and Sudan.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Monday it had sold 50,000 tonnes of Australian Standard White (ASW) wheat to Sri Lanka for delivery in late January and 60,000 tonnes to Sudan for delivery in January, March and April.
The AWB also expects to participate in upcoming tenders for wheat from Egypt and Pakistan, a spokesman told Reuters.
Trade sources said the Egyptian tender would total between 400,000 and 500,000 tonnes, while Pakistan's requirements would be in excess of 300,000 tonnes.
As of Monday, pool deliveries of wheat in Australia had climbed to 18.5 million tonnes, underscoring a sluggish cash market, the AWB spokesman said.
